basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home nestled in the heart of the Excelsior of San Francisco. Spanning 947 square feet, this property offers a cozy and functional living space. The kitchen is equipped with a built-in oven gas range and refrigerator, making it ideal for culinary enthusiasts. Enjoy family meals in the convenient eat-in kitchen area. Relax by the fireplace on cooler evenings and appreciate the warmth it brings to the home. Laundry hookup is conveniently located in the utility room, ensuring ease of access. The property includes lots of storage space and a garage space for added convenience and security.  Huge backyard, great for family gathering and BBQ.   Easy access to 101 and 280. Walking distance to City College, Safeway, Balboa Park BART, bus stops, light rail stations, restaurants, coffee shops, schools, McLaren Park, Geneva Ave & Mission St. This is a special opportunity to enjoy comfort, charm, and versatility in one of San Francisco most connected neighborhoods. House needs some TLC.
